top_signals.title: Bahrain Bond Selloff Revives Memory of 2018 Rescue by Gulf Peers
top_signals.summary: A selloff in Bahrain’s bonds is pushing its borrowing costs to levels last seen during the nation’s 2018 crisis, when its wealthier Middle East allies stepped in with a financial rescue.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Ryanair, Lufthansa CEOs Say Tough Pilot Checks Still Leave Risks
top_signals.summary: European airlines and regulators can only do so much to deter cockpit attacks like the one during a recent FlyDubai flight, and the aviation industry must accept there’s “no absolute safety and security” even with stringent vetting of pilots.
